messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: GPU provisioning error for cluster-prod-2 — autoscaler failed to add nodes (queue growth > 1200). Pager: PD-67890

nina: I'm on it, taking primary oncall. linking PD-67890 here.

marc: saw the alert, queue backlog spiking since 03:42 UTC. Token queue length trending +300/s.

luca: customer-reports: several customers seeing 503s from API v1/generate. CS flagged a large customer (acme-inc) with timeouts.

emily: yep, Acme reporting long waits ~60-90s and some job cancellations. adding to incident notes.

nina: quick status — autoscaler logs showing repeated errors: "AttachRole call failed (AccessDenied)" and launchtemplate mismatch errors.

marc: pasting clipped autoscaler error: ```time="2026-03-15T03:45:12Z" level=error msg="failed to create instance: InvalidInstanceProfile: Cannot assume role: arn:aws:iam::123456:instance-profile/redwood-gpu-profile: AccessDenied"```

joey: also seeing launch template drift: cluster config expects LT v12, ASG uses v9. Autoscaler refuses to proceed because node labels/taints won't match.

anjali: runtime note — when autoscaler falls back, request queue is throttled by the scheduler. KV cache fills and prefix cache gets evicted, upstream latencies jump.

karim: any immediate mitigation? Can we manual-scale the ASG to add nodes while we fix IAM?

marc: we can, but the ASG will still launch instances with incorrect launch template/iam if we don't patch it. Two options: 1) force ASG to use a known-good launchtemplate via asg update, then increase desired, or 2) hand-provision nodes and join them to the cluster (kubeadm/ssm).

nina: doing option 1 as fastest path. Joey, can you push a temporary LT override to the ASG and bump desired from 12 -> 24? We only need short-term capacity for hot queues.

joey: on it. running: ```aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name prod-gpu-asg --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0abcde,Version=12 --desired-capacity 24```

deploy-bot: deploy started by joey at 2026-03-15T03:47:05Z — updating ASG.

marc: while that's happening, I'm going to relax the cluster-autoscaler check that blocks nodes with mismatched taints. temp patch: set --skip-nodes-with-system-pods=false? That might help but risky.

anjali: careful — skipping those checks can lead to pods stuck on new nodes with mismatched GPU drivers. Suggest we also push a pre-install bootstrap script to the LT for nvidia driver + kubelet flags.

joey: LT update applied. ASG scaling from 12 -> 24 in progress. Cloud events show 8 instances launching.

marc: autoscaler logs now: "successfully created node group" for 4 nodes, but some EC2s failing to attach instance profile, status=InstanceProfileNotAssociated.

marc: help text: ```aws ec2 describe-instances --instance-ids i-0f...``` shows instanceProfileArn empty.

nina: looks like the instance profile association IAM call intermittently fails due to a recent IAM policy change. Security ticket in flight?

karim: security team rolled a tighter policy yesterday for instance-profile:AssumeRole, may have omitted the autoscaler service principal. Paging sec infra.

luca: customer impact update: Acme reported partial recovery on some requests but tail latency still high. I'm sending a short status note: "Investigating GPU provisioning issues; partial capacity restored, degraded performance persists"

emily: thanks, include ETA ~30-45m.

joey: manual fix applied to 3 instances via SSM: attached instance profile and restarted kubelet. Those nodes are Ready.

marc: new metrics: queue length down from 1,200 -> 520 after first 6 nodes joined. Error rate still elevated.

anjali: we should also divert non-GPU jobs to CPU pool to reduce pressure. Propose a routing rule change: for small inference (seq < 256) route to cpu-fast cache. Can we flip that quickly?

nina: let’s do that. joey/anjali prepare config, marc will update routing rules in gateway.

joey: pushed temporary routing flag: ```route-override: service.match(seq_len:<256) -> cpu-fast```. Deploying now.

deploy-bot: routing config change deployed at 2026-03-15T04:03:10Z.

marc: early effect: queue drain rate improved, GPU backlog down to 180, token cost per second normalized.

karim: security confirmed policy diff. Sec infra is re-granting autoscaler role to assume the instance-profile for the ASG. ETA 20m.

nina: next actions: 1) wait for sec to finish role fix 2) let ASG finish scale + verify all nodes have proper instance profile and LT 12 3) revert routing change after backlog clears 4) postmortem owner marc.

luca: notifying Acme support slack and assigning a follow-up call if they need.

emily: prepping customer-facing incident email (post-incident) with timeline and mitigations.

marc: tracking note in incident doc: autoscaler failure root causes = IAM policy removal + LT drift + autoscaler conservative checks -> combined led to provisioning stall and queue saturation.

nina: good. keep this channel for ops-only updates. I'll bump priority and set a 15m checkin cadence.

marc: 04:12 UTC: sec infra reports fix applied to role binding. New instance profile associations succeeding. Autoscaler resumes creating nodes.

joey: ASG at desired 24, 20 nodes in Ready state now. Scheduling catching up.

anjali: runtime checks: KV cache warmup happening, prefix hit-rate improving — expect normal latencies in ~8-12m.

luca: Acme confirmed reduced error rate, they still see high p95 but ok for now.

nina: last_status: capacity restored, significant throughput improvement. Keeping channel open until we fully revert temporary routing changes and finish postmortem.

karim: assigning postmortem to marc + oncall nav: root cause analysis and action items (IAM guardrails, LT drift detection, autoscaler more resilient fallback).

nina: thanks everyone. outbound summary incoming to #incidents in 10m.

deploy-bot: incident closed? manual flag pending.

marc: leaving open until routing reverted and postmortem created.

nina: checkin 04:30 UTC planned.
